import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static long[] ten_pow = new long[17];

    static String to_string(BigInteger x) {
        if (x.equals(BigInteger.ZERO)) return "0";
        String s = x.abs().toString();
        if (x.signum() < 0) {
            return "-" + s;
        }
        return s;
    }

    static void solve_by_split(List<Integer> arr, int offset, BigInteger[] total) {
        int n = arr.size();
        List<Integer> first_half = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> second_half = new ArrayList<>();
        
        traverse_first(arr, 0, 0, offset, first_half, n);
        
        traverse_second(arr, n / 2, 0, second_half, n);
        
        Collections.sort(first_half);
        Collections.sort(second_half);
        
        long sum_second = 0;
        for (int x : second_half) {
            sum_second = (sum_second + x) % MOD;
        }
        
        int j = second_half.size() - 1;
        for (int x : first_half) {
            while (j >= 0 && (x + second_half.get(j)) >= MOD) {
                j--;
            }
            long term1 = (long)x * second_half.size();
            long term2 = sum_second;
            long term3 = (long)(second_half.size() - 1 - j) * MOD;
            total[0] = total[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(term1 + term2 - term3));
        }
    }

    static void traverse_first(List<Integer> arr, int idx, int cur, int offset, List<Integer> first_half, int n) {
        if (idx == n / 2) {
            first_half.add((cur + offset) % MOD);
            return;
        }
        traverse_first(arr, idx + 1, cur, offset, first_half, n);
        traverse_first(arr, idx + 1, (cur + arr.get(idx)) % MOD, offset, first_half, n);
    }

    static void traverse_second(List<Integer> arr, int idx, int cur, List<Integer> second_half, int n) {
        if (idx == n) {
            second_half.add(cur);
            return;
        }
        traverse_second(arr, idx + 1, cur, second_half, n);
        traverse_second(arr, idx + 1, (cur + arr.get(idx)) % MOD, second_half, n);
    }

    static long count_numbers(String prefix, long limit, String n_str) {
        long val = 0;
        for (char c : prefix.toCharArray()) {
            val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
        
        long cnt = 0;
        int plen = prefix.length();
        int nlen = n_str.length();
        
        for (int len = plen; len <= nlen; ++len) {
            if (len < nlen) {
                cnt += ten_pow[len - plen];
            } else {
                if (prefix.compareTo(n_str) < 0) {
                    cnt += ten_pow[len - plen];
                } else if (prefix.equals(n_str)) {
                    cnt += limit - val * ten_pow[nlen - plen] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        
        String ns;
        if (n == 0) {
            ns = "0";
        } else {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            long t = n;
            while (t > 0) {
                sb.append((char)('0' + (t % 10)));
                t /= 10;
            }
            ns = sb.reverse().toString();
        }
        
        ten_pow[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            ten_pow[i] = ten_pow[i-1] * 10;
        }
        
        BigInteger[] result = new BigInteger[1];
        result[0] = BigInteger.ZERO;
        
        for (int num_len = 1; num_len <= ns.length(); ++num_len) {
            for (int diff_pos = 0; diff_pos < Math.min(num_len, ns.length()); ++diff_pos) {
                String cur_str = "";
                long cur_val = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < diff_pos; ++i) {
                    cur_str += ns.charAt(i);
                    cur_val = cur_val * 10 + (ns.charAt(i) - '0');
                }
                
                for (int d = 0; d <= 9; ++d) {
                    if (diff_pos == 0 && d == 0) continue;
                    if (diff_pos < ns.length() && d == (ns.charAt(diff_pos) - '0')) continue;
                    if (num_len == ns.length() && d > (ns.charAt(diff_pos) - '0')) continue;
                    
                    String new_str = cur_str + (char)('0' + d);
                    long new_val = cur_val * 10 + d;
                    
                    long base = 0;
                    String tmp = "";
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < new_str.length(); ++i) {
                        char start_char = (i == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                        for (char c = start_char; c < new_str.charAt(i); ++c) {
                            base += count_numbers(tmp + c, n, ns);
                        }
                        tmp += new_str.charAt(i);
                    }
                    base += new_str.length() - 1;
                    
                    List<Integer> vars = new ArrayList<>();
                    tmp = new_str;
                    for (int i = new_str.length(); i < num_len; ++i) {
                        int cnt = (int)(count_numbers(tmp + '0', n, ns) % MOD);
                        vars.add(cnt);
                        tmp += '0';
                    }
                    
                    base += 1;
                    base -= new_val * ten_pow[num_len - new_str.length()];
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < vars.size(); ++i) {
                        int idx = vars.size() - 1 - i;
                        vars.set(idx, (vars.get(idx) - (int)(ten_pow[i] % MOD) + MOD) % MOD);
                    }
                    
                    int b = (int)(base % MOD);
                    if (b < 0) b += MOD;
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < vars.size(); ++i) {
                        int v = vars.get(i) % MOD;
                        if (v < 0) v += MOD;
                        vars.set(i, v);
                    }
                    
                    solve_by_split(vars, b, result);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Handle exact prefixes
        String prefix = "";
        long val = 0;
        for (int len = 1; len <= ns.length(); ++len) {
            prefix += ns.charAt(len-1);
            val = val * 10 + (ns.charAt(len-1) - '0');
            
            long cnt = 1;
            String tmp = "";
            for (int i = 0; i < prefix.length(); ++i) {
                char start_char = (i == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                for (char c = start_char; c < prefix.charAt(i); ++c) {
                    cnt += count_numbers(tmp + c, n, ns);
                }
                tmp += prefix.charAt(i);
            }
            cnt += prefix.length() - 1;
            cnt -= val;
            cnt %= MOD;
            if (cnt < 0) cnt += MOD;
            
            result[0] = result[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(cnt));
        }
        
        result[0] = result[0].mod(BigInteger.valueOf(1000000007));
        pw.println(to_string(result[0]));
        pw.close();
    }
}
